page.layout: One column of verse in the centre; running head at top; page number top right; marginal notes in the right margin (P., Al.) beside lines 3, 14, 27 and 36; a column of small marks in the left margin beside every line, not legible enough to transcribe.

main_text.p: Nil tamen hoc habuisse Viro praclarum in se, Nec sanctum magis,& mirum,doctumque videtur. Quantum oleis salices, quantum saliunca rosetis,P. Quantum ulula cygnis, Philomela cedit hirundo: Tantum indicio nostro tibi cedere fas est, Damon, quotquot habet pastores Teutonis ora, Aurea Brettani damnantes scripta Philonda, Romanamque suis centonibus Artolatriam Firmantes, totumque novis erroribus orbem Turbantes: scabiem pecoris pestemque redemti Sanguine Christe tuo: cuius fex impia carnem Implere humanam duro nimis afferit ore, Terrasque tractuque maris, coelumque profundum. Delicia nostra, Damon, dum fata finebant;Al. Dulces delicia: quis te felicius unquam Lappasque, tribulosque, interque nitentia culta Infelix lolium, & steriles euulsit avenas? [?] Quando te latuit, si forte horreret in aruis Carduus, & segetis non utilis herba subiret? Runcina ubi tua nunc? ubi rastrum & mystica vannus. Pectien ubi? rutrumque, irpexque, teresque cylindrus? Quo complanatur creta solidanda tenaci Area, ne mures subeuntes horrea ponant, Neu fodiant in ea sibi grata cubilia talpa, Neue canis latitet bufo, neu farris aceruum Curculio populet, collectis frugibus hostis. Omnia nunc squallent in agris, sinetaque moestaP. Excipiunt actos magnis aquilonibus imbres, Subsistuntque nova lacrymosa in palmite gemma, Falx quoniam Damonis abest, qua doctius uti Nemo ipso potuit: quoties resecare fluentes Vidimus hunc ramos? quoties compescere frondes Luxuria nimia crescentes, latior inde Surgeret ut cultis hortis propaginis ordo? Non agri tantum, non vinea sola requirit Solertem Damonis opem: sed apes quoque dulciAl. Ante suas solita distendere nectare cellas, Iam tristes languent, sacuisque examina ducunt Rara fauis, tractimque sonant graviore susurro, Ag minibus pigris ad pabula nota volantes, Damonis desiderio, qui defuncta sape

page.notes: Left margin: a column of small signs, one beside each verse line, which I could not read reliably and have not transcribed. Right margin notes P. and Al. are transcribed where they stand. Doubtful readings: "euulsit" (word 17, the letters before "ulsit" are unclear) and "actos" (line 28). Printed spelling and u/v forms ("ulula", "aruis", "moesta") are copied as set in the scan, with u/v adjusted only where the rule applies.
